title: trichomanes nicobaricum
intro: Trichomanes nicobaricum, commonly known as the Nicobar fork moss, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Hymenophyllaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Trichomanes nicobaricum include its bronchodilatory, anti-tussive, and anti-asthmatic properties, which help to relax the airways and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
